about.text: "farmhouse cheese", prepared using raw unpasteurised milk.

sources.text: Raw-milk farmhouse Gouda/Edam/Leiden type; TSG since 2007; milk may be cow, goat, sheep or buffalo, at least half from the producing farm; ripening range not verified
